planets.name: K2-141 c
planets.description: Transiting planet of K2-141 with a 7.75-day year, found in 2018.

text.card: K2-141 c was found in 2018 by K2 as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 2 planets known around K2-141. Its orbit and size follow Bonomo et al. 2023's fit, the archive's default.
